title: Show Checking... after a Check press on the band?
context: After someone presses Check on the HUD band, the band can show 'Checking...' until the sign-off result comes back. Nothing on disk records the press, so Checking... would come only from the band's own memory of the press: it clears when the check result lands (checked_at moves past the press), the state changes, the turn ends, or after 10 minutes, then goes back to 'Waiting <age>' with the Check button, so it can never stick. Dropping it is simpler: the band shows 'Waiting <age>' until the result is in. The High Table recommends showing it. (Spec pipeline chief question, grounded in docs/modules/design-sign-off/index/summary.md.)
